info.about: Pokémon Emerald Version is a 2004 role-playing video game developed by Game Freak and published by The Pokémon Company and Nintendo for the Game Boy Advance. It was first released in Japan in 2004, and was later released internationally in 2005.
info.why: Released in May 2005 as the third Hoenn version, after Ruby and Sapphire had done most of their selling, and never re-released in any form; counterfeit carts are common, so verified originals carry a premium.
